units.source_text: 在北山的中川北山村，有国营和市营两种公共汽车，

en.t: In Nakagawa Kitayama Village in Kitayama, there are two kinds of buses, national and municipal,

units.source_text: 市营公共汽车开到京都市（已经扩大）北郊的山麓就折回，

en.t: the municipal buses go as far as the foothills on the northern outskirts of Kyoto City, which has already expanded, and then turn back,

units.source_text: 而国营公共汽车则一直驶至远方的福井县小浜地方。

en.t: while the national buses continue all the way to the distant Obama area of Fukui Prefecture.
